MR 与 RM 在本页平面模型中只在原点给出相同点像；不能虚构非零平面重合点。固: In this planar model, MR and RM agree on a point only at the origin; there is no nonzero planar coincidence. The fixed M/E example shows that a nonzero single probe can also be insufficient.
candidateSet 必须含一到八个互不重复的合法操作标识。: candidateSet must contain one to eight distinct valid operation identifiers.
first 和 second 必须是八操作模型中的合法标识。: first and second must be valid identifiers from the eight-operation model.
point 必须包含两个 −2 到 2 的整数，不接受布尔值、小数或字符串。: point must contain two integers from −2 to 2; booleans, decimals, and strings are not accepted.
② 用两支单位箭头比较整个操作: 2. Compare the complete operation with two unit arrows
③ 把基矢的像读成矩阵列: 3. Read the basis images as matrix columns
④ 检查封闭性与撤销操作: 4. Check closure and undoing an operation
一个点相同还不够。依次跟踪 e_x 和 e_y，并保留每一步的坐标。: Agreement on one point is not enough. Follow e_x and e_y separately, retaining the coordinates after each action.
三维嵌入说明不涉及空间平移、自旋、Bloch 相位或磁群分类。: The three-dimensional embedding discussion does not include spatial translations, spin, Bloch phases, or magnetic-group classification.
两条路径给出不同的点像，且两个矩阵不同；这对操作不可交换。: The two paths give different point images and different matrices; this pair of operations does not commute.
两条逐步路径与对应复合矩阵一致: Both stepwise paths agree with their composite matrices
主动操作作用于平面实列向量，坐标轴不动；矩阵的第 j 列是第 j 个单位基矢的像: Active operations act on real planar column vectors while the axes stay fixed; matrix column j is the image of unit basis vector j.
先作用 first，再作用 second，因此列向量左边写 second·fir: Apply first and then second, so second·first appears to the left of the column vector. Compare the second path with the chronological order exchanged.
全部三操作组合满足结合律: All triples of operations satisfy associativity
八操作的全部乘积都在模型内: Every product of the eight operations remains in the model
固定 z 镜像与三维正旋转的行列式不同: The fixed-z mirror and the proper three-dimensional rotation have different determinants
固定单探针反例由第二个独立基矢区分: The second independent basis vector resolves the fixed single-probe counterexample
固定反例比较 M 与 E：它们都保持 e_x，但对 e_y 的作用不同。它独立于: The fixed counterexample compares M with E: both preserve e_x, but they act differently on e_y. It is independent of the operations and point selected above.
坐标、矩阵、两条路径、乘法表和闭包判断都由 Python 精确整数计算；网页只选: Python computes the coordinates, matrices, both paths, multiplication table, and closure decisions with exact integers; the page only selects and draws returned values.
所选点的两条路径碰巧相同，但两个矩阵不同；检查两支独立的单位箭头才能比较整个线性: The two paths happen to agree on the selected point, but their matrices differ; inspect two independent unit arrows to compare the complete linear maps.
方形轮廓和两支单位箭头是操作探针，不把颜色或箭头当作改变物体对称性的化学标记。: The square outline and two unit arrows are probes of the operations; colors and arrows are not chemical labels that change the object's symmetry.
本页先研究二维平面作用。若三维嵌入保持 z 不变，得到 C₄ᵥ；三维正旋转点群: This page first studies the two-dimensional planar action. An embedding that fixes z gives C₄ᵥ; the corresponding operation in the proper three-dimensional point group D₄ also reverses z and is a twofold rotation about x. The groups are abstractly isomorphic but act differently in three dimensions.
本页只计算固定八操作模型，不做任意矩阵群闭包或点群鉴别。: This page calculates only the fixed eight-operation model; it does not close arbitrary matrix groups or identify point groups.
模型包含八个不同的精确矩阵: The model contains eight distinct exact matrices
正方形的八元素平面二面体群；本页记为 D₄。: The eight-element planar dihedral group of the square, denoted D₄ on this page.
每个逆操作的左右乘积都是单位操作: Both products with each inverse are the identity operation
比较完整基底得到的判断与矩阵相等判断一致: The complete-basis comparison agrees with matrix equality
生成元列表不一定是完整群。寻找缺失乘积，补全生成闭包，并用左右单位乘积检查逆操作: A generator list need not be a complete group. Find a missing product, generate the closure, and check inverses using identity products on both sides.
生成闭包以完整的无新增轮次结束: The generated closure ends after a complete round with no additions
生成闭包先加入单位操作，再反复计算当前集合的全部有序乘积；最后一轮没有新增元素才: Generating the closure first adds the identity, then repeatedly evaluates every ordered product in the current set; it stops only after a complete round adds no element.
矩阵两列等于两个单位基矢的像: The two matrix columns are the images of the two unit basis vectors
第一列记录 e_x 的像，第二列记录 e_y 的像。两列都相同，才是同一个平面线: The first column records the image of e_x and the second the image of e_y. Both columns must agree for the planar linear maps to be identical.
结合律允许改变括号，不允许任意交换操作的先后。: Associativity permits changing parentheses, not arbitrarily exchanging the order of operations.
表项 AB 先作用 B，再作用 A。: Entry AB applies B first and then A.
输入必须是对象。: The input must be an object.
这两个操作在整个平面上可交换；两条路径对每个基矢和每个点都给出相同结果。: These operations commute on the entire plane; both paths agree for every basis vector and every point.
